name: USDigiTarget | Autocomplete Address For WooCommerce
author: USDigiTarget

sections.description:
USDigiTarget’s Autocomplete Billing Address plugin for WooCommerce enhances the checkout process by integrating Google Maps API to auto-complete addresses. This smart solution reduces manual entry errors, speeds up checkout, and improves customer satisfaction. By leveraging geolocation and real-time suggestions, it ensures precise address inputs, minimizing delivery mishaps and returns. Perfect for businesses looking to streamline order fulfillment and enhance user experience.

External Scripts

This plugin includes the Google Maps JavaScript API for fetching and auto-completing addresses. The API key must be configured in the plugin settings for the script to function properly. Make sure to obtain a valid Google Maps API key with the necessary permissions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Settings’ -> ‘USDigiTarget Google Maps API’ section to configure the plugin settings. Follow the on-screen instructions to enter your Google Maps API key and enable the autocomplete feature as needed.
